test_set.english: A single term for: the committee's motion was accepted by vote but was never put into effect by the secretariat — the approval and the enactment are two distinct facts that are constantly conflated.
A single term for: the pull request was approved by reviewers but the change was never merged or deployed — the sign-off and the shipping are two distinct facts that are constantly conflated.
A single term for: the policy was ratified by the board but no department ever implemented it — the adoption and the operation are two distinct facts that are constantly conflated.
A single term for: the test suite was reported green in the review but the fix was not present in the shipped build — the check and the delivery are two distinct facts that are constantly conflated.
A single term for: the budget line was approved in the vote but the funds were never actually released — the authorization and the disbursement are two distinct facts that are constantly conflated.
A single term for: the migration was marked complete in the changelog but the schema was never altered — the report and the operation are two distinct facts that are constantly conflated.
A single term for: the security patch was accepted by the change board but never installed on the fleet — the clearance and the deployment are two distinct facts that are constantly conflated.
A single term for: the standard was adopted by the working group but no vendor implemented it — the acceptance and the use are two distinct facts that are constantly conflated.
A single term for: the feature was signed off in the review but the code path is not reachable in production — the approval and the availability are two distinct facts that are constantly conflated.
A single term for: the resolution was carried in the assembly but the executive took no action on it — the passage and the execution are two distinct facts that are constantly conflated.
A single term for: the incident was marked resolved in the tracker but the root cause was never addressed — the closure and the remedy are two distinct facts that are constantly conflated.
A single term for: the contract was approved by legal but it was never countersigned or executed — the review and the signature are two distinct facts that are constantly conflated.
